title: Polynomial-time closure under Boolean negation
statement: Let $p$ be a Boolean-valued function on bit strings, and suppose the function sending $x$ to the one-bit word $p(x)$ is polynomial-time computable. Then the function sending $x$ to the one-bit word $1-p(x)$ is polynomial-time computable.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a function from bit strings to Boolean values.
The one-bit output function $x\mapsto p(x)$ is polynomial-time computable.
